description: The League Info Officer (LIO) is GNGRLL's communications and information hub, responsible for reaching the full league population with the right message at the right time. This role runs the mass email blasts (registration pushes, certified-volunteer process, merchandise store, photo logistics), maintains the public information website and registration portal, and reports registration and player-count numbers to the board throughout the season. The LIO also coordinates photo day scheduling with the photographer, manages merch/fanwear ordering announcements, and compiles the end-of-season survey and season retrospective for the board.

calendar.title: End-of-season survey open to families
calendar.description: Launch the post-season survey to players' families and coaches capturing positives, negatives, and complaints for the board's season retrospective.

calendar.title: Season retrospective / survey review at board meeting
calendar.description: Present compiled end-of-season survey results and season recap/feedback to the board for the fall planning cycle.

calendar.title: Sponsorship / donor recognition update
calendar.description: Coordinate sponsor thank-you and donor management materials (plaques, banners, framed jerseys) alongside the president and sponsorship coordinator.

calendar.title: Registration opens - launch announcement
calendar.description: Push the season-open registration email to the full league population and run/promote open registration nights; begin tracking signup numbers by division.

calendar.title: Season calendar / key dates published
calendar.description: Finalize and post key dates (registration open, clinics, assessments, draft, season start, photo day, playoffs, All-Stars) to the website and email.

calendar.title: Website / IT refresh for new season
calendar.description: Update the information website: URL changes, division info pages, calendar, and registration-portal links for the coming season.

calendar.title: Certified Volunteer Process blast
calendar.description: Email all registered users the annual 3-step certification process (register, background check, yearly Abuse Awareness Training) and badge pickup details.

calendar.title: Registration update - division signup counts
calendar.description: Report division-by-division signup counts to the board as registration approaches close, flagging under- or over-subscribed divisions.

calendar.title: Assessment tally / rankings prepped for draft
calendar.description: Compile and adjust assessment tallies and player rankings for the board and player agent ahead of the drafts.

calendar.title: Photo Day scheduling with photographer
calendar.description: Coordinate picture/photo day dates with the photographer, tied to uniform delivery, and set makeup/backup dates.

calendar.title: Final registration / total player counts reported
calendar.description: Report final registration numbers and total player counts by division to the board once rosters are set.

calendar.title: Team photo scheduling for remaining teams
calendar.description: Work with the photographer to set up photo opportunities for any teams that still need photos during their remaining games.

calendar.title: Photo packet pickup / online order reminder
calendar.description: Remind families that photo packets are available for pickup and that photos are ordered directly through the online portal by the order deadline.

calendar.title: Fenway / Hadlock family experience outings
calendar.description: Organize and announce the Red Sox (Fenway) and Sea Dogs (Hadlock) family experience outings for league families.

calendar.title: Merch / fanwear store open announcement
calendar.description: Announce the online merch store link for browsing/ordering, noting pickup-only/pre-order lead-time details.

calendar.title: Hat orders / merch site wind-down and refunds
calendar.description: Wind down the merch/hat store for the year and process any pending order refunds.

calendar.title: Post-season survey results review by division
calendar.description: Present post-season survey results and season discussion broken out by division at the end-of-year board meeting.
